range_model_finding.interpretation: The fresh FE85=00 run fits direct AppKit codes. The older saved FE84=40 run fits the full-to-limited model. Keep capture range mode attached to each comparison; AppKit is not an HDMI framebuffer reference.

recommendation.reason: FE85=00 has zero pixelwise B1 2px ROI error, minimum C1 1px grid error among phase-aligned values, and matches the ROM-cleared bit-1 state. FE85=20 reduces full-frame direct-code MAE by only about 0.016 Y code while slightly worsening those detail ROIs.
